records.resolution: Changed L001-Q1 to a storage-unit context and mapped bitmap-header assessment to L008-Q1 and AQ010-Q3.
Restricted AM080-Q4 to flat-file, relational and DBMS foundations taught by L080; retained SQL assessment after L084.
Made AQ100-Q5 assess L100 control structures and moved flowchart-to-pseudocode assessment to AQ105-Q1 after L101.
Restricted the Section 9 review item to scalar identifier-table entries and mapped array terminology to AQ115-Q5.
Replaced the premature ADT comparison with an array-of-records task; mapped ADT assessment to Quiz 125 and L122.
Replaced the premature lifecycle comparison with a Section 11 modular-program design task; mapped lifecycle assessment to L142-Q2 and AQ145-Q2.
Added a visible CORE array/index/bounds prerequisite bridge at the start of L104 before search and sort.
Removed the over-broad dependency on completing every register type; L042 depends on the architecture foundation taught in L041 and defines the registers it transfers.
Removed the over-broad dependency on completing the full bus requirement; the architecture/bus foundation is already visible in L041 before L042 notation.
